eyebrow: A price drop crosses the line
code:
Position: 1 ETH collateral @ 2,000 USDC, 1,000 USDC borrowed
Liquidation threshold: 80%

Health factor = (2,000 * 0.80) / 1,000 = 1.60   <- safe

ETH price drops to 1,200 USDC:
Health factor = (1,200 * 0.80) / 1,000 = 0.96   <- eligible
caption: Nothing about the loan changed -- a pure market price move crossed the line.
Not the protocol team -- an open, competitive race to capture the bonus.

code:
Liquidator repays: 500 USDC of debt (50% close factor cap)
Liquidation bonus: 5%

Collateral seized: 500 * 1.05 = 525 USDC worth of ETH
  (at 1,200 USDC/ETH --> 0.4375 ETH)

Liquidator's profit: 525 - 500 = 25 USDC
Borrower's remaining: 0.5625 ETH collateral, 500 USDC debt
caption: The bonus is the economic incentive that makes someone show up instantly.
